## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

apiup is a command‑line tool that starts a local mock REST API server from an OpenAPI 3.x specification with a single command. It follows an XDG‑style convention for configuration, allowing you to place your spec in ~/.openapi/spec.json or .yaml and customize host, port, and mode via a simple config file. In mock mode it automatically returns example responses defined in the spec, or a generic placeholder when none are provided, and can list routes without launching the server. The tool also supports validation of the OpenAPI document and can be installed via pip or uv, making it easy to integrate into development workflows. Developers building or testing client applications can quickly spin up a realistic API mock without writing any server code.
